body:
The SATECON Kickoff Conference, held on 4 November 2025 at the Institute of Marine Biology, University of Montenegro, brought together partners from Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, and Montenegro to launch a shared programme of smart and sustainable agriculture and mariculture.

This gallery captures moments from the opening addresses, project presentations and exchanges between partners. My participation provided an opportunity to discuss the project’s ambitions, understand the partnership’s complementary expertise and explore connections between technological innovation, institutional cooperation and producer needs.

These priorities also underpin my subsequent assignment as Senior Advisor for Blue–Green Innovation and Collaboration Platforms, contracted by the Institute of Marine Biology. My contribution combines strategic advice and policy alignment with support for collaboration platforms, reporting, quality assurance and capacity building.

For me, the value of this cooperation lies in helping turn research and technological investment into practical, lasting results. The relationships established in Kotor provide a foundation for connecting institutions, supporting knowledge exchange and developing collaboration that can continue beyond the project’s lifetime.
